$comment: Pure data. Every value here is expected to be WRONG on first pass and re-tuned against the headless harness (Assumption 3, FR-33). Changing a value here must never require a code change.

arena.$comment: Ruling C - arenaRadius = f(budget), exposed as a data value. Budgets are a closed set (FR-10), so the function is a table. CI asserts radiusByBudget keys === match.legalBudgets exactly.
arena.$comment_minFleetSeparationFraction: Minimum pairwise fleet-centroid separation as a fraction of arena RADIUS. Equidistant placement on the inset shell gives 2*insetFraction*sin(180deg/N)*R; the tightest supported case is N = match.maxFleets = 5 which yields ~0.846*R. 0.8 holds for N=2..5. createMatch asserts placement satisfies this.

destruction.$comment: AoE does not check ownership (Decision 13). Boundary deaths detonate only if the detonation point is still inside the arena (FR-26).

collision.$comment: Collision damage scales with relative velocity and mass (FR-22). damage = coefficient * reducedMass * relativeSpeed^2, applied to BOTH bodies.

physics.$comment: Finite-thrust movement (feature: finite-thrust-movement). maxAccel is the engine's bounded acceleration in world-units per sim-second^2 — a waypoint burn fires at maxAccel for |deltaV|/maxAccel seconds, then coasts, so paths CURVE while thrusting (see src/sim/physics/thrust.ts). Baseline value taken from the Gate-1 prototype's MAX_DV_PER_TURN / dt relationship (prototypes/gate1/main.ts:107-112) — a full-beat burn still reaches the per-ship deltaVPerTurn budget for every catalog engine. S06 owns the balance re-tune of this value. movementModel is the version marker the determinism-fixture re-record keys on (D-VERSION-RERECORD / Custom Rule 3): 1 = the impulsive-only model the current hash-locked fixtures were recorded under; S06 bumps to 2 and appends the re-recorded generation once downstream sessions actually emit segments.
